description: Today's GPU rental prices: the price index in USD per GPU-hour for each GPU (H100, H200, A100, B200, B300, RTX PRO 6000), with 1-day, 1-week and 1-month changes, the index day and a link to each GPU's page. Give one GPU to also get its benchmark contract, each provider's average price standardized to that contract, and its compute futures prices: each exchange listing a contract on its rental price, with the last price and 24-hour volume, read within the last minute (all of them: https://computescreener.com/futures). For past values use get_price_history; for providers' posted prices get_provider_prices; for a cost estimate_gpu_cost.

gpu.description: One GPU; omit for all listed GPUs.

name: get_gpu_prices

change_1d_pct.description: Percent change from the value 1 day earlier

change_1m_pct.description: Percent change from the value 30 days earlier

change_1w_pct.description: Percent change from the value 7 days earlier

price.description: Latest index value, USD per GPU-hour

read_at.description: When its prices were last read

provisional.description: True while the day is not over

updated.description: When the GPU prices were last calculated (ISO 8601, UTC)

title: GPU rental prices
